Guide my steps... let that song light the path ahead!
Heeheehee... heh... what should I do? What can I do? Heehee...
Such a wonderful melody deserves a price...
Everywhere is filthy, base noise... I crave a more splendid tone...
To me, other music is nothing but noisy clamor...
If everyone would offer themselves, we could make an even sweeter tone...
That melody surrounding me... I haven't had enough... I want to hear it again...
You simply haven't heard that perfect melody yet... don't be left speechless when it begins...?
The performance guides my body... my hands and feet rise on their own...

End me... so that I may never hold a sword again...
Do your lives need my protection...? How foolish of me...
Cold, dark teardrops are all I have left.
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.despair.0: Endless despair fills my chest once more...
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.despair.1: Despair piles up like shattered stone, tearing, leaving scars...
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.despair.2: If I cannot protect... then let me fade away...
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.despair.3: I swore to protect, yet I've betrayed them time and again...
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.normal.0: Weathered by frost and snow, only worn-down pride remains...
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.normal.1: I couldn't protect anything... now not a single one is left.
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.normal.2: Don't wake me. Let me sleep forever.
DESPAIR_KNIGHT.backgroundText.normal.3: I thought nothing would ever change... yet the world shifted, and everything is different now.

FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.momentarySati: Rotten meat covered in scars tastes foul...
Meat is best fresh. Eat while it is warm...
This is how the fairies' numbers dwindle... you will guard me forever...
FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.normal.0: I crave something fresh... I have been hungry for so very long...
FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.normal.1: So few fairies remain to guard me...
FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.normal.2: The fairies that gently care for me... they are the most precious of all...
FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.normal.3: What can sate this hunger? Only fresh meat...
FAIRY_QUEEN.backgroundText.starvedFrenzy: Perhaps I have been hungry too long. This is becoming unbearable...
Come to me... it is time to repay the price of that care...

Quit staring at me like that. The pitiful ones are you...
Even tied up like this, you'll still be scared of me.
Let me go... What gives you the right to keep me bound?!
You can tie down my body... I can still move.
FORSAKEN_MURDERER.backgroundText.strengt: ...Why... why can't I use my strength... W-what do I do now?
I know I was wrong... I'll behave... P-please don't hit me anymore...
I'm scared... I'm scared I'll see something I shouldn't...

FUNERAL_OF_THE_DEAD_BUTTERFLIES.backgrou: Where do people go after death?
Offer remembrance to the dead, and condolences to the living.
Eternal sleep... may you rest in peace.
Long ago, people believed they would become beautiful things with tiny wings after death.
This coffin bears an empty faith, solely to mourn those with nowhere to return...
Please stop tormenting yourself. I will help you be released.
To the poor souls sunk deep in grief... my sincerest condolences.
This place does not even have a single proper flower.

GALAXY_FRIEND.backgroundText.normal.1: We promised we would always stay together.
GALAXY_FRIEND.backgroundText.normal.2: This star will always stay beside you.

You're so kind, aren't you? Let's do it again, okay?
I'm so touched that you'd play with someone like me...
HAPPY_TEDDY_MONSTER.backgroundText.embra: Come here. I'll hold you gently, so you can feel warm affection.

HAPPY_TEDDY_MONSTER.backgroundText.norma: Will you play with me? I'm so lonely.
It's all right. Don't be scared. We're only playing together.
Do you want to feel this warm affection?
If only I could hold your hand and dance with you...
I just want to whisper a few little secrets to you...
Please don't bully me... I'm already torn and ragged, and my stuffing is spilling out.

HISTORY_FLOOR_EMERALD_BOUGH_BOSS.backgro: How I wish I could be like you... so at the very end, I would not be overlooked by him...
My life began as yearning, became a curse, and in the end must bring happiness to others.
Until the very end... I have been waiting...
How I wish you would look at me... wake me from this nightmare... even just once... only once...
I am no longer your machine... I will set out on a journey that needs no one's help.
If I could rot away... would these feelings bloom into pure, unblemished flowers?
Day after day, the one waiting to rot, to become fertilizer... is not you, but I, more despairing than anyone...
A machine... born from that man's obsession, anger, and sorrow...
Everyone may find happiness... except me...
I cannot leave; only heaps of putrid things lie beside me.
HISTORY_FLOOR_EMERALD_BOUGH_BOSS.name: Emerald Bough
HISTORY_FLOOR_END_LIGHT_BOSS.backgroundT: Was my birth itself a sin?
Loneliness and longing are branded into my heart, yet they cannot ignite me.
In the darkness, I am alone... yes, buried deep in this solitude.
Was it truly so hard to give me a place among everyone in that happy ending?
When the matchlight goes out, nothing of me remains.
This is not hot at all. It is terribly cold... my heart has long gone cold.
I will burn away everything bright.
Perhaps once I burn out, I can be free.
This is my revenge: burning down everything he yearned for.
If I had seen even a trace of warm light, how could I be filled with resentment?
HISTORY_FLOOR_END_LIGHT_BOSS.name: End Light
HISTORY_FLOOR_FLUTTERING_BOSS.background: In this City, pure kindness does not exist.
If I pour everything into you, then you must repay me.
If I am to be left alone... then I may as well devour everything.
If I tried to have a kind heart, would the fairies bless me? ...A fairy tale like that could never come true.
Did you truly think you could accept help without paying any price?
For one who has hungered this long... this is the happiest feast...
Past blood and tears opened possibilities for us? They were only another person's leftovers.
Things that can fill the stomach... are few, and not so few.
If I swallow it all, will it fill my hollow hope...?
HISTORY_FLOOR_FLUTTERING_BOSS.name: Fluttering
HISTORY_FLOOR_FLUTTERING_MASS.name: Fairy Mass
HISTORY_FLOOR_FORGOTTEN_BOSS.backgroundT: I remember you... you were someone with a warm smile...
Why do you never look straight at me? Why do you always turn your back...
I will always be watching you.
I wish you would simply tell me what I did wrong.
The red ribbon... the only thing about me like her, the only memory connecting me to her.
I am only a miserable substitute for someone who longed for love.
Why make me imitate the one who remembered you?
I was always abandoned, yet I foolishly believed he would someday open his arms to hold me...
I only wanted the happiness in front of me.
I was not abandoned at the end. I... had already been abandoned from the beginning.
HISTORY_FLOOR_FORGOTTEN_BOSS.name: Forgotten
HISTORY_FLOOR_LAST_MATCH.name: Last Match

HISTORY_FLOOR_WASP_BOSS.backgroundText.n: This place may be written into history... but who will remember me, the one who gave everything for it?
History repeating itself again and again means nothing.
No one remembers those who gave their lives for the kingdom. That truth repeats forever.
Establish your will by looking back on the past? You know nothing about my past...
A machine that leads them out of hell... Angela... do not make me laugh.
No one may speak lightly of my beginning.
Once torn apart, these wings can never fly again.
Looking back on the past... that part is not difficult.
Why must that painful past be uncovered? No one is willing to face my past...
I will never again accept anyone's orders...
HISTORY_FLOOR_WASP_BOSS.name: Queen Bee

KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.attackFailu: I thought you were nothing but cowards... but you have some skill, don't you?
I didn't expect you to actually block me... Next time, I'll be more serious.
Not bad... but the next punch won't be this easy.
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.attackSucce: Too easy. You really aren't a match for me.
How was that? Getting punched hurts a lot, doesn't it?
I wasn't even trying that hard... You're easier to deal with than I thought.
Good. I'm getting serious now. Try blocking this if you can.
The amber gate glittering with greed... Here I come!
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.king.0: I wished for everyone to be happy... but I never realized my own happiness was part of that...
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.king.1: This empty feeling... I'm so hungry... I want more...
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.king.2: If I fill my stomach, I know I'll be happy... I want happiness...
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.magicalGirl: It's been so long... since I fought like this.
Is everyone ready? Then come on.
This feeling... it really takes me back. Let's have some fun, shall we?
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.normal.0: It's been so long... since I fought like this.
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.normal.1: Is everyone ready? Then come on.
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.normal.2: This feeling... it really takes me back. Let's have some fun, shall we?
KING_OF_GREED.backgroundText.normal.3: I wished for everyone to be happy... but I never realized my own happiness was part of that...
I'm so hungry... I can't stand it anymore...
This greedy, filthy hunger... I can't bear it...

LETICIA.backgroundText.default.0: I can't just leave my dear friends behind… so I came up with the perfect plan!
LETICIA.backgroundText.default.1: Don't worry~ only naughty kids make their friends sad.
LETICIA.backgroundText.default.2: When you open the gift, you'll be so surprised! You'll really jump, okay?
LETICIA.backgroundText.default.3: What's inside? That's a secret—if I told you, it wouldn't be fun!
LETICIA.backgroundText.default.4: Friends never fight, right~ that's how it should be!
LETICIA.backgroundText.default.5: Come play with me! Laugh out loud with my friends!
LETICIA.backgroundText.lonely.0: No one's smiling here… it looks so lonely.
LETICIA.backgroundText.lonely.1: My friends… where did they all go…?
LETICIA.backgroundText.lonely.2: They left because they hate me, didn't they… will you be my friend?
LETICIA.backgroundText.lonely.4: Leaving alone is so sad… be my friend, please?
LETICIA.backgroundText.withFriends.0: The more friends, the livelier it gets here!
LETICIA.backgroundText.withFriends.1: I hope this place is full of laughter!
LETICIA.backgroundText.withFriends.2: I hope I can make lots of friends here~
LETICIA.backgroundText.withFriends.3: Like my little pranks? Fun, right? Right, right? That face!
LETICIA.backgroundText.withFriends.4: Happy to be my friend? Mm, I'm super happy too!

LITTLE_RED_RIDING_HOODED_MERCENARY.backg: Leave that sneaky bastard... to me.
I want that bastard's head hanging by my bed. That's the only way I'll sleep soundly.
I'm a professional. I can butcher it alone. You don't need to interfere.
I've been sharpening my blade for days. For no reason other than cutting off that beast's head.
Out of my way... This is my business. I have to finish this contract myself.
Just help me kill that thing... and I can help you. But the last blow is mine.
You think you can win? Stop dreaming...
Die!!! Let me hear that miserable howl of yours again!!!
I can't die before that beast does... Die... just die!!!
Hey... are you showing off that you're stronger than me? Or did you never trust me to begin with?
Fine... if this is how you're challenging me... then I'll carve you up just like you want!!!
I will personally kill that blue bastard!!!

PHILIP.dialogue.allyDeath.1: In this situation, I won't last long...
PHILIP.dialogue.allyDeath.2: If I knew it was this dangerous, I shouldn't have come...
PHILIP.dialogue.battleStart.0: At this rate, I'll only drag everyone down...
PHILIP.dialogue.battleStart.1: I can't keep hiding behind my seniors...
PHILIP.dialogue.battleStart.2: With my strength... I should be able to hold them off.
PHILIP.dialogue.enemyDeath.0: I'm honored to be of help.
PHILIP.dialogue.enemyDeath.1: This is when we strike without hesitation, right...?
PHILIP.dialogue.enemyDeath.2: If I don't step forward, nothing will ever change.
PHILIP.dialogue.selfRetreat.0: I'm sorry... I'm not strong enough. I can't hold on...
PHILIP.dialogue.selfRetreat.1: I'm a coward. I can't do anything...
PHILIP.dialogue.victory.0: We took losses too... but the result is what matters.
PHILIP.dialogue.victory.onlySelf: ...Even if we won, what does it mean?

Existences like you, neither good nor evil... must be destroyed...
To the loathsome fiends who stand in my way... behold the great magic of love...
Without shadows there is no light, and because of that, true evil must exist in this world...
I am the chosen one... I am not like you... not like you!
Don't trample on... the meaning of my existence!!!
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.0: Why is everyone so happy? If this keeps up, I won't be able to do anything.
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.1: I have always believed that as long as I exist, evil must also exist.
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.2: The evil I must defeat... you've finally appeared...
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.3: Without darkness, there can be no light... Because you exist, I can stand here...
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.4: You are evil, disturbing the peace of this place. Justice is with me... Those who stand against it must be... erased!
QUEEN_OF_HATRED.backgroundText.normal.5: To preserve the peace of the world... I was chosen.

SALVADOR.dialogue.allyDeath.yunaAfterPhi: ...At this age, and yet I feel grief once again.
SALVADOR.dialogue.allyDeath.yunaBeforePh: Ah... Philip, don't push yourself. Retreat while you can.
SALVADOR.dialogue.battleStart.0: Don't think this will end quickly.
SALVADOR.dialogue.battleStart.1: Friends, you're frailer than I expected.
SALVADOR.dialogue.battleStart.2: These old bones still carry plenty of experience.
SALVADOR.dialogue.enemyDeath.0: Your moves are getting predictable. You're tired, aren't you?
SALVADOR.dialogue.selfDeath.afterYunaDea: I have no attachment to what's left... but I'm still worried about that boy.

SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.backgroundText.0: Step by step... everything is burned away...
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.backgroundText.1: These matches are the only hope left in my life...
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.backgroundText.2: What will the next matchlight reveal?
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.backgroundText.3: When a shooting star falls, someone reaches heaven. Whose star was it...?
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.backgroundText.4: After the last match goes out, will you leave me too?
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.dialogue.attack.1: This one will light the end.
SCORCHED_GIRL_MONSTER.dialogue.battleSta: I still have one final match...
If this flame goes out, so do I.
Don't leave me alone in the dark.
Please... just a little more warmth.
This is the last ember I can hold.
No... even this light is gone...

Continue... don't let the music stop...

TECHNOLOGY_FLOOR_GRINDER_MK4_BOSS.backgr: A machine must operate according to its designer's will.
This is the principle given to me... I can only do this...
Why must we go this far just to collect energy?
In our world, machines rebelling became an old fable... how laughable.
What I was given was nothing but irresistible, meaningless commands.
A machine's behavior is always clear, but will it forever operate as prescribed...?
A machine has no value of its own; when principles cannot change, distinguishing good from evil is meaningless.
...I am the AI Angela, your secretary, here to help you adjust to your new workspace.
In most domains I am unmatched; I can do the work of dozens at once.

TECHNOLOGY_FLOOR_MK4_HELPER.name: All-Around Helper Mk2
TECHNOLOGY_FLOOR_REGRET_BOSS.backgroundT: I never had any worth. No one feels guilt over a rusted machine...
You should be glad you've been freed from duty...
End... begin... end... begin... and then... it ended.
Not only abandoned, but forced to bear the cost in their stead...
Sin hidden beneath the guise of a greater good...
Who is it that bound me — the researchers, or those they sought to save...
Do they feel any regret for that silent, sanctioned treatment...
What did I see... what was I forced to see...?
Still shackled by hatreds and revulsions of days past...
A diseased script, a machine slowly numbed, losing all sense of guilt...
They speak of treating illness... while not knowing what the illness even is...
TECHNOLOGY_FLOOR_REGRET_BOSS.name: Regret
TECHNOLOGY_FLOOR_SOLEMN_MOURNING_BOSS.ba: This coffin, bearing hollow faith, exists only to mourn the homeless...
This coffin is far from enough to console the innocents who sacrificed themselves for others.
You cannot bear the weight of these butterflies.
Where do the dead go, and where does all that hope end up?
Entrust grief to the departed, offer condolences to the living...
I too once wished to never witness death again.
Feebly beating its wings, awaiting the inevitable end.
What did they do wrong? What did I do wrong?
A funeral needs only solemnity, not spectacle.
Tears of sorrow merely soak the wings in vain.

THE_FOURTH_MATCH_FLAME.name: The Fourth Match Flame
TODAYS_SHY_LOOK.backgroundText.expressio: What the fuck do you idiots want from me?! Am I supposed to keep grinning like a moron?!
You motherless piece of shit... read the damn room!!!
Please do not peek behind me. That is basic courtesy...
Why is a sad expression unsuitable for the City...?
Some days, you just feel listless.
I am not in the mood to chat right now. Could you come back later?
It is fine. I am just a little shy...
Could my impression improve a little? I hope so...
My mood is wonderful, like being wrapped in warm, gentle sunlight.
Will you bloom into a smile like me?
